statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Friday NQ trading has reached the weekly close, removing active one-way path risk; residual risk is now concentrated in weekend headlines and the eventual reopening gap.
recommendation: The mapped state reflects closed-market conditions. Friday's hawkish rate repricing remains relevant background, while any escalation would depend on a newly verified weekend catalyst with plausible index-level transmission.
headline: Weekly close removes active NQ path risk; weekend headline risk remains
body: U.S. cash equities ended lower after Chair Warsh reinforced the inflation fight: the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.52%. Cboe VIX finished near 14.43, and Friday's late path included meaningful two-way movement rather than a persistent no-retracement finish. CME NQ is now closed for the weekend, so residual risk is primarily reopening-gap risk from rates, energy or geopolitical headlines.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail was mostly low-to-watch while Stress peaked around Jackson Hole. Tail reached 27% at 17:00 UTC and 25% at 19:00 UTC during the delayed downside leg, then eased to WATCH at 20:00 UTC before the weekly close.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours are entirely inside the normal weekend closure for NQ. Path-based Tail should remain low unless a newly verified discontinuity materially changes Sunday reopening expectations; Stress can stay above normal because Friday's hawkish repricing and unresolved Hormuz risk remain in the background.
